reason: I already pay for Claude Pro and I'd just ask it to help me sharpen my question, pick a theory and draft an interview guide. I'd use the free framework diagram, but I don't see why I'd pay $49 for the rest when my subscription already does most of it.
objection: Honestly it's not the money, it's that I can't tell what this does that my AI subscription doesn't. 'Verified citations' and transcript analysis sound nice, but I'd need to see they're clearly better than what I get from ChatGPT before paying again.
would_change_my_mind: A couple of people in my cohort WhatsApp saying the transcript analysis and interview guide saved them real time, or my programme recommending it.
